items.question: What is already built?
items.answer: Password sign-in with sessions and rate limiting, subscription billing with checkout and a paid-access gate, transactional email, an account settings area, and a design-token system that drives every screen.

items.question: Does changing the landing page mean writing code?
items.answer: No. This page is composed from content/homepage.json — the blocks on it, their order, and every word are data. Changing the page means changing that file.

items.question: How is accessibility handled?
items.answer: Every screen is checked against WCAG 2.2 AA by an automated axe pass in CI, and the colour tokens are contrast-tested on every run rather than documented and trusted.

items.question: How are dependencies managed?
items.answer: Every dependency is pinned to an exact version, install-time scripts are disabled, and new packages are checked against a known baseline before they can enter the build.
